chunks: They said: 'Surely you are not Joseph!' He said: 'I am Joseph, and this is my brother. God has been gracious to us; for God does not verily deprive those who fear Him and are patient of the recompense of those who are good.'

key_terms.الْمُحْسِنِينَ: The doers of good / The righteous

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Joseph say to his brothers when he revealed his identity?
ai.summary: In this pivotal moment, Prophet Joseph (peace be upon him) reveals his identity to his brothers, attributing their survival and elevation to divine grace rather than his own merit. He cites the principle that God does not waste the reward of the righteous who possess piety and patience, a verse that Shia scholars often highlight as a testament to the enduring virtue of *sabr* (patience) and *taqwa* (God-consciousness) in overcoming trials. This declaration underscores the theological concept that ultimate success is a result of God's mercy upon those who remain steadfast in their faith.
